title: Strangler edge route manifest
description: Route manifest as code for the nginx strangler edge (plan §1.5). One entry per path prefix; the generator (infra/nginx/generate-routes.mjs) renders this into nginx map/location blocks. A route flip = edit one entry's `upstream`/`tenants` here + regenerate + reload; rollback = revert that one line + regenerate + reload.

path.description: URL path prefix this route matches, rendered as an nginx `location` prefix match. Must start with '/'. Exactly one entry with path "/" is required as the default catch-all.

upstream.description: Target upstream service name. php_backend is the strangler default (plan §1.5); the other three are the Node set that participates in blue-green (plan §4.6).

tenants.description: "all" routes every tenant's traffic on this path to `upstream`. An array of tenant slugs scopes the flip to only those tenants (per-tenant canary, plan §7.3); every other tenant falls back to php_backend for this path.

note.description: Free-text rationale for this route (why it's flipped, which phase/ticket owns it). Not rendered into nginx config; documentation only.
